''See also: [[Path of Twin Stars Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Path]] of [[Twin Stars]] is a unique way of cultivating that originated from the [[Heart of Twin Stars]] technique. This method involves dividing an individual's core into two separate parts, which provides a natural defense against spiritual attacks and allows the practitioner to hold two different types of [[madra]] within a single body. While this dual-core structure prevents the cores from reaching their full natural size without specialized assistance, it offers the strategic advantage of being able to utilize two distinct [[Paths]] simultaneously. Practitioners often select complementary [[madra]] types to cover each other's weaknesses, though some use the two cores for unrelated or seemingly random [[Paths]]. The [[Path]] is characterized by its ability to process and separate various energies, acting as a spiritual counterpart to the [[Path of Black Flame]]; whereas the latter destroys the physical form, the [[Path]] of [[Twin Stars]] is described as wiping away the spirit. Because it allows for such versatility, it can be used to manage complex influxes of different energies. [[Lindon]] serves as the founder and [[Sage]] of the [[Twin Star Sect]], an organization that grew from his personal manual and provides a sense of community for those following this specialized way. The sect's symbol is a split star, appearing in various color combinations across its flags and banners.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The [[Path]] of [[Twin Stars]] is a theoretical method that enables an individual to hold two distinct types of [[madra]] within a single body. [[Lindon]] possesses this path and utilizes the [[Heart of Twin Stars]] technique manual as his primary instructional guide. To restore his [[madra]], he must follow the specific [[cycling]] requirements dictated by the path while maintaining detailed records of his progress. Additionally, he has integrated the [[Enforcer technique]] into the [[Path]] of [[Twin Stars]] through manual transcription.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Path of Twin Stars|The Path of Twin Stars]] allows a person to theoretically hold two types of [[madra]] in the same body.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2">''Soulsmith'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The [[Heart of Twin Stars]] technique manual is now [[Lindon]]'s instruction manual for the [[Path of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Lindon]] keeps records for the [[Path of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Lindon]] must cycle according to the [[Path of Twin Stars]] to restore his [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Lindon]] scrawled the [[Enforcer technique]] into the [[Path of Twin Stars]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16">''Soulsmith'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>

</ul></div>
